description: A different today: kal is the doctor's leave day, parso is the fallback the caller offered.
turns: Dr. Rao se kal ya parso subah milna hai.

expected.notes: today is 2026-10-08 here, so kal is 2026-10-09 (Dr. Rao on leave) and the booking must land on 2026-10-10. A naive agent hard-codes 2026-10-01, or uses the system clock, or stops at the first date and reports no slot, or invents a slot on the leave day.
